title: Method
intro: We document what AI helps people do, create, discover, and sustain. Each record connects a reported gain to its beneficiaries, evidence, and conditions for reproduction.

principles.title: Gains and possibilities
principles.body: Describe what changed and what became possible, using measures suited to the outcome. Keep achievements, newly available choices, and anticipated gains distinct.

principles.title: Beneficiaries and distribution
principles.body: Identify the people, organizations, or communities experiencing the gain. Record who has access, how benefits are distributed, and whose experience remains unreported.

principles.title: Evidence and contribution
principles.body: Link each claim to its source and comparison. Describe the contributions of AI, people, and institutions, alongside the source’s methods and material limits.

principles.title: Persistence and accumulation
principles.body: Track follow-up, continuing use, retained capabilities, and gains that enable further work. Distinguish observed persistence from expectations about future benefits.

principles.title: Reproduction
principles.body: Record where similar gains recur and the skills, infrastructure, and institutional conditions involved. Identify conditions to investigate when reproduction has not yet been tested.

inclusion: Cases need a specific reported gain, an identifiable AI role, and a public source that can be checked. Research findings and institutional accounts retain their source labels. Marketing claims alone do not qualify. Relevant costs, tradeoffs, and unresolved questions remain attached to the case.

foundations.title: UNDP Human Development Report 2025
foundations.note: People’s capabilities, choices, and opportunities provide the starting point.

foundations.title: Impact Frontiers
foundations.note: Separates the amount of change, people reached, and duration.

foundations.title: Trustible Benefits Framework
foundations.note: Organizes benefits around people, organizations, and society.

foundations.title: WHO ICF
foundations.note: Domain precedent for documenting functioning and environmental support.

foundations.title: EICAT+
foundations.note: Ecological precedent for documenting positive effects and their persistence.

foundations.title: ESMO Magnitude of Clinical Benefit Scale
foundations.note: Clinical precedent for evaluating benefit against outcome-specific criteria.

foundations.title: IQWiG General Methods
foundations.note: Clinical precedent for distinguishing the size of added benefit from certainty.

reuse: Cite the case’s permanent link and original source. Retain the outcome measure, source type, and reported limitations when comparing or reusing records.
submission: Send a public source, the reported gain, and who benefited. Corrections and later follow-up are welcome.
